search_window.basis: Supplementary recall of newly indexed distinct high-value reporting since the previous committed watch; production collector/publisher remains authoritative. Late-recalled November 17 publication date, exact publication time unverified.

findings.title: Israel drops explosives packaged in boxes in Gaza

reported_event_date_range.precision: Reported discrete operations on November 10 and 16 and a November 13 displacement account; exact incident times unknown

findings.location: Zeitoun and Tuffah east Gaza City; Bureij, Nuseirat, eastern Deir al-Balah, and eastern al-Maghazi in central Gaza; near Dar al-Salam Hospital in northeastern Khan Younis, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Reported demolition/damage of Palestinian homes and other buildings through remotely detonated boxes dropped by quadcopter drones. Local sources told Anadolu dozens fled Zeitoun on November 13 fearing more demolitions. Number of persons independently confirmed displaced and full structural damage total unknown.
findings.affected_population_or_system: Housing/infrastructure damage and displacement of residents; Anadolu attributes reports to local sources, residents, witnesses and described video, without independent confirmation of the specific device or count.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Local sources said dozens of Palestinians fled Zeitoun neighborhood on Friday, fearing their homes would be targeted next.
findings.source_type: Established news agency; on-the-ground eyewitness/local-source reporting with described video, not independent technical confirmation

discovery_context.discovery_method: Recovered in the last of 12 targeted searches following OCHA OPT and WHO official-first checks; inspected source report directly and compared with 18 prior Gaza watch heartbeats.
discovery_context.reporting_context: Prior watches captured demolitions and Deir al-Balah military advances, but not this specifically reported drone-delivered explosive-box tactic, additional Zeitoun/Tuffah, Nuseirat and Khan Younis locations, or the reported dozens fleeing Zeitoun. This is late-recalled reporting dated November 17 rather than proof the tactic began during the current hourly window.
discovery_context.corroboration: Anadolu cites witnesses and footage; the reported tactic, location-level counts and displacement lack independent corroboration in OCHA/WHO or Reuters within this bounded check.
discovery_context.limitations: Individual eyewitnesses unnamed; video not independently authenticated in this watch; military attribution and event timings unverified. Counts are source reports, not independently established facts.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only; not a primary publisher or collector.

Search indexing frequently returned 2023-2025 or months-old articles. The absence of recent material in these sources does not prove no incident occurred.

coverage_notes.overall: One distinct late-recalled account of multi-site explosive-box drone demolitions with witness-reported flight in Zeitoun; medium confidence on the attributed eyewitness reporting, not independent verification of tactical details.
